notes.title: Bonus Stage Publishing joins fartastic journey of Billy Bumbum and DEMO IS OUT
notes.notes:
I just copy/paste this press release here. You can guess how happy I am. 😍 🥰

//start of press release
Bonus Stage Publishing, a small but mighty video game publisher based in the heart of Lapland, is thrilled to announce its partnership with Dutch indie game studio Frambosa. Together, they're releasing a fartastic new game called Billy Bumbum that's all about butts and farts (and puzzles too, we guess).

The game's demo is launching today and trust us, it's a hoot. You play as a cube with a butt, and you have to use your butt skills to flip, push, and fart your way through a ton of challenging puzzles. There are over 100 levels to play, and they're all set in colorful, magical worlds full of cute critters and quirky characters.

"The first time we heard the pitch of this game, we were immediately hooked. I mean, you're a butt of a dragon and you save your friends using your farts. And the way Jonathan has made the game to be really wholesome and fun, it just keeps amazing us", tells the Bonus Stage's spokeperson anonymous.

As if the game's butt-centric gameplay wasn't enough, Billy Bumbum is also taking part in the Steam Puzzle Fest, which is like a big ol' party for puzzle games. It's happening now, and we're pretty sure Billy and his magic winds are going to be the life of the party.

"I'm really proud of what we've created with Billy Bumbum," said Jonathan Barbosa, the game's designer and lead butt wrangler. "It's a game that's all about having fun and being silly, and I think players are going to love it. Plus, who doesn't love a good fart joke?"

Billy Bumbum is set to launch later this year, and we can't wait for you to get your hands on this butt. Also you should stay away from other butts. May Billy be your only true butt to play with. Stay tuned to Bonus Stage Publishing's social media channels for more updates on the game, including behind-the-scenes peeks at our butt modeling process (it's more complicated than you might think).

ABOUT FRAMBOSA
Jonathan Barbosa's Frambosa is a Dutch game studio and general mischief-maker. He loves games, butts, farts, and anything else that makes people laugh. Rumour has it he's dreaming in puzzles nowadays.

ABOUT BONUS STAGE PUBLISHING
Bonus Stage Publishing is a leading Finnish video game publisher based in the icy wonderland of Lapland, Finland. We specialize in bringing you the weirdest, wildest games out there, because life's too short to be serious all the time.

Presskit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zJjxffmitVkXfTyi6ElzCXAbrZOUAV0a

//end of press release
